question: Who among the following is the author of the novel ‘Animal Farm’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**George Orwell**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **George Orwell** is the author of the novel 'Animal Farm'.
 
• 'Animal Farm' is a political allegory published in 1945.
 
• The novel critiques the Russian Revolution and the subsequent establishment of the Soviet Union.
 
• It uses a farm and its animal inhabitants to symbolize different classes and types of people involved in the revolution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **George Orwell** was an English novelist, essayist, journalist, and critic.
 
• He is also known for his dystopian novel **'1984'**, which was published in 1949.
 
• Orwell's works are characterized by lucid prose, social criticism, opposition to totalitarianism, and support of democratic socialism.
 
• 'Animal Farm' and '1984' are often used in educational settings to discuss themes of power, corruption, and the impact of political systems on individual freedom.
